podcast.body: Co-written by Wayland Holyfield and Bill Hall, this song was featured as the wedding song for Bud and Sissy in *Urban Cowboy*. Murray, fresh off a Grammy win for "You Needed Me," had intended it as a duet, even recording both male and female parts on the demo, hoping Kenny Rogers would sing with her. The song became a massive hit, reaching number one on the Billboard country charts and number 33 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Well her instincts were right. Could I have this dance went to number one on the Billboard country charts and it snuck into the top 40 at number 33."
This song was featured in the movie "Urban Cowboy" as the piece Bud and Sissy danced to at their wedding. "it was Ann Marie's. Can I have this dance?"
